Coaches FAQ

Is ScorX free for coaches?

Yes. ScorX Free costs nothing and needs no credit card. It includes live scoring, match invitations, rotations and playing time, the post-game triage dashboard, plays, drills, Training Sessions, drill assignment and team results, and iPad Team Mode. Free covers up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games, and ScorX Premium removes those limits.

What are Match Invitations and how do they work?

Match Invitations let coaches send a pre-game notification directly to each player's family before game day. Parents accept the invite, confirm attendance, and are set up to record their child's stats during the game. The coach sees the full team stat view in real time. It turns a single-person chore into a team effort.

How does distributed stat recording work?

When a coach sends match invitations, each parent records their own child's stats from within the app during the game. The coach sees an aggregated team view updated in real time. This removes the bottleneck of one person trying to track 15 players simultaneously.

What is the Post-Game Triage Dashboard?

After each game, players submit a structured self-reflection covering what went well and what to improve. The Triage Dashboard aggregates these submissions across the whole roster and surfaces the most common struggle areas as a ranked list, ready for your next training session. It also shows how many players have submitted so you can prompt stragglers. The dashboard is free.

What does Perception vs Reality analysis show me?

Perception vs Reality compares each player's self-assessed performance against their actual recorded statistics. It surfaces overconfidence (a player thinks they played well but the data disagrees), underconfidence (a player undervalues a genuine strength), and coaching blind spots. It makes development conversations evidence-based instead of opinion-based.

How many teams and players can I manage?

ScorX Free covers up to 5 teams, 25 players and 20 saved games. The 20 games are a total, not a monthly allowance, so at the cap you can't save a new game until you delete one or upgrade to ScorX Premium. Premium has no limit on teams, players or saved games.

How do I plan training and test my squad?

In the Train tools you can build plays and drills, put them into Training Sessions and run a session with beep pacing. You can also assign a drill or fitness test to your squad and see the team results. All of this is free. The Beep Test, 800m time trial and 2km time trial are free run drills, and the full run drill library with sprint and interval drills is part of ScorX Premium.

Can I import my squad from a spreadsheet?

Yes. Team import accepts a spreadsheet in .xlsx or .csv format, such as a PlayHQ export, so you don't have to type each player in by hand. It is free.

Can I record stats by voice?

Yes, with ScorX Premium. Voice stat recording works for team sports and needs iOS 26 or later.

Does ScorX work on iPad?

Yes. iPad Team Mode is free. It includes a magnet board and lineup planning, and Plan Mode takes you through planning your lineup and configuring the statistics you want to record.

What does ScorX Premium add for coaches?

ScorX Premium adds weekly AI training recommendations, generated from your team's match statistics and player self-assessments. It identifies the specific areas where your team struggled and suggests targeted training priorities, not generic drills. Premium also adds voice stat recording, the full run drill library, PDF and CSV export, iCloud sync, and removes the limits on teams, players and saved games. Everything else in Train, including benchmarking, is free. It costs A$4.99 a month or A$49.99 a year, with a 30-day free trial and no card required.
